tasks.description: Independently review bounded cleanup of expired unattached first-aid photo uploads through existing private maintenance.
constraints: Independent Review and QA, local gates only. Controller owns live staging checks and usage limits.
Preserve existing retention and guest cleanup. Claim the photo asset before Storage removal, preserve attached and historical photos, retry failures and late objects without reopening deleted assets.
No bulk staging operation, 024 or StoreKit changes. Verify the scoped service-only maintenance path.

acceptance_criteria.description: Production entrypoints type-check and exact diff is clean.
HTTP and SQL fixtures cover both lock orders with attach, orphan retry, preserved history, scoped auth and guest cleanup.
